skill.name: cwa-weather
skill.description: 用中央氣象署（CWA）開放資料 API 查各縣市與鄉鎮的天氣預報（天氣現象、降雨機率、氣溫、舒適度）。天氣、天氣預報、氣溫、降雨機率、明天天氣、週末天氣、台北天氣、高雄天氣的問題適用。需要在 opendata.cwa.gov.tw 免費申請的 API 金鑰。颱風警報、豪雨特報、地震速報請用 taiwan-weather 的 NCDR CAP feed（免金鑰）查詢；沒有金鑰時的天氣備援也是 taiwan-weather（Open-Meteo 免金鑰）。
skill.summary: Retrieve official Taiwan county and township forecasts using a CWA API key.
skill.author: tahodev

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are false positives from Markdown backticks, official CWA links, dataset descriptions, and readable multilingual text. Predictable temporary files create overwrite and forecast-tampering risks, while command-line authorization URLs can expose API keys. No evidence found of prompt injection, malicious exfiltration, or concealed executable content.

remediation.issue: Forecast downloads use predictable paths in a shared temporary directory.
remediation.suggestion: Use a private temporary directory with restrictive permissions and unique filenames, or pipe responses directly into the parser.

remediation.issue: Authorization keys appear inside command-line URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Use a protected curl configuration or an HTTP client that keeps keys outside process arguments; redact authorization URLs from logs.

content.value_statement: Taiwan weather requests need reliable local forecasts with clear time periods. This skill guides CWA API queries for county and township forecasts using your authorization key.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve 36-hour county forecasts from the CWA F-C0032-001 dataset.
Request multiple counties together or retrieve all counties.
Interpret weather conditions, rain probability, minimum temperature, maximum temperature, and comfort indicators with forecast periods.
Retrieve township forecasts from F-D0047 datasets and filter districts locally.
Handle missing keys, authorization errors, timeouts, server errors, and invalid responses without inventing forecasts.
Direct keyless forecast and warning requests to the separate taiwan-weather skill.
limitations: Requires a valid CWA API key and network access; shell examples also require curl and jq.
Township dataset IDs outside Taipei require catalog verification; township location filters may require local processing.
Typhoon warnings, heavy-rain advisories, and earthquake reports are outside this skill; alternate feeds require the separate taiwan-weather skill.
Historical test samples are not current forecasts, and documented API behavior may change.

use_cases.title: Plan a Local Trip
use_cases.description: Review temperature ranges and rain probabilities for the next 36 hours before visiting a Taiwan county.

use_cases.title: Compare Work Locations
use_cases.description: Compare forecast periods across multiple counties to support outdoor work scheduling.

use_cases.title: Prepare a District Weather Brief
use_cases.description: Retrieve a township dataset, select the requested district, and summarize conditions with explicit forecast times.

prompt_templates.title: Check One County
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Taipei City weather for the next 36 hours using my configured CWA key. Include forecast periods, temperatures, and rain probabilities.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Counties
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Taipei City and New Taipei City forecasts for tomorrow. Match forecast periods and include rain probability, temperature ranges, and comfort indicators.

prompt_templates.title: Select a Township Forecast
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve Taipei township forecasts and filter locally for Daan District. Summarize available periods and weather fields without exposing my configured authorization key.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Forecast Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Query county and township forecasts for Taipei using private temporary files. Validate responses, limit retries, and report failures without substituting historical data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced retrieval with security and reliability requirements

best_practices: Keep authorization keys outside replies, commits, process arguments, and logs.
Use private temporary storage or direct parsing, and validate each API response before summarizing.
Include forecast periods, verify dataset identifiers, and distinguish official forecasts from alternate sources.
anti_patterns: Presenting historical examples or failed responses as current weather.
Assuming township locationName parameters reliably filter every district.
Using this forecast skill as a substitute for authoritative emergency warnings.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Obtain a CWA authorization key from its open-data platform. Missing or invalid keys produce authorization errors.

faq.question: Which forecast areas are supported?
faq.answer: The instructions cover county forecasts and township datasets. Taipei township access is documented; other county dataset IDs require catalog verification.

faq.question: What weather details can I request?
faq.answer: County forecasts include weather conditions, rain probability, minimum and maximum temperatures, comfort indicators, and forecast periods.

faq.question: Can this skill retrieve emergency warnings?
faq.answer: Emergency warnings are outside its main scope. It refers to the separate taiwan-weather skill and official CWA announcements.

faq.question: Why do township results include other districts?
faq.answer: The documented township request returns all districts despite locationName. Select the requested district locally after downloading the dataset.

faq.question: What happens when the API fails?
faq.answer: Use a 30-second timeout and one or two retries for connection or server failures. Report unresolved errors without inventing forecasts.
